name: gi-plugins
description: Production AI tooling for Grounded Intelligence clients.

plugins.name: lee-internal-comps
plugins.description: Comps (internal Dealius + external CoStar, lease & sale), demographic and business-key-facts reports, owner-of-record lookup, labor-shed workforce, traffic counts, owner mailing lists, and guided marketing-flyer intake for Lee & Associates Raleigh brokers. Headliners: internal-comps and internal-and-external-comps (Excel + Lee-branded PDF), demographic-summary/-detail and business-key-facts (Lee-branded PDFs), owner-lookup, labor-shed, owner-mailing-list, add-comps, lee-flyer-brief (guided flyer brief: pulls comps/demographics/owner data, broker curates, provenance-tagged brief, Claude Design handoff), vpd-lookup (traffic counts / AADT for the busiest roads near any NC address, with a flyer card), and nearby-businesses (Area Amenities map kit for any NC address: nearby businesses ranked by prominence with brand logos on a basemap, returned as a downloadable designer kit the marketing team composes into the flyer's amenities map), and comp-map (Lee-branded competitive-set map for an NC listing: deal mode maps the comps around a subject with numbered pins, rings, and a matching comp table; database mode maps the whole internal set or a broker's deal history; returns a shareable ~30-day interactive Google map link + print-ready PNG + a csm-* comp-table fragment for flyers/OMs/BOVs). Plus process-mapping: a guided interview that maps any team member's repeatable process into a clean process-map document for GI (CRE = firm context, role-agnostic).
